translations.系统安排请求的先后和批次，管理缓存，并协调计算任务；这里不是临时替用户挑选模型。: The system schedules request order and batches, manages the cache, and coordinates computing tasks. It is not choosing a model for the user on the fly.
translations.系统把模型计算结果整理成调用方可以接收的内容，不必总等到全部生成完成后才返回。: The system prepares model results for the caller; it does not always wait for all generation to finish before returning content.
translations.系统把许多请求排队并组合处理，以提高运行效率。: The system queues and batches requests to run efficiently.
translations.系统收到要处理的文字、对话、图片或其他内容。: The system receives text, chat, images, or other content to process.
translations.让程序调用或接口请求进入 vLLM: Bring program calls or API requests into vLLM
translations.请求由程序直接调用或兼容 OpenAI 的接口进入后，vLLM 会整理输入、安排: After a request arrives through a direct program call or an OpenAI-compatible API, vLLM prepares input, schedules requests and computing resources, runs the model, and returns results all at once or progressively.
translations.调用方一次性或逐步收到模型回答、生成内容和相关运行信息。: The caller receives model answers, generated content, and related execution information all at once or progressively.
translations.调用方主动要求添加时仍能覆盖默认值: Callers can still explicitly override the default to request an additional token
translations.调用方仍可明确要求添加: Callers can still explicitly request it
translations.调用方收到完整结果，或在使用流式输出时逐步收到内容。: The caller receives a complete result, or receives content progressively when streaming.
translations.输入成为等待模型处理的任务。: Input becomes a task waiting for model processing.
translations.输入文字、对话、图片或其他需要模型处理的内容。: Supply text, chat, images, or other content for the model to process.
translations.运行提交中新增的针对性测试: Run the focused tests added in the commit
translations.还有什么不知道？: What do we still not know?
translations.这一步把人能理解的对话和图片整理成模型真正读取的输入。: This step turns human-readable chat and images into the input the model actually reads.
translations.这张工作图根据 vLLM 项目说明和目标配置建立理解，不代表每个模型、入口和硬件: This workflow is based on the vLLM project documentation and target configuration. It does not mean every model, entry point, and hardware combination follows exactly the same execution path.
translations.这是一次模型工作的起点，内容可能来自人、应用或其他系统。: This is the starting point of a model request; content may come from a person, an application, or another system.
translations.这是根据代码变化和未验证范围给出的检查建议，不代表这些检查已经完成。: These checks are suggested based on the code change and unverified areas; they have not necessarily been completed.
translations.这是用户或应用最终拿到模型结果的边界。: This is the boundary where the user or application receives the model result.
translations.这是请求跨进 vLLM 边界的位置，不把启动服务的命令误当成用户提交请求。: This is where requests enter vLLM. Starting the service is not the same as submitting a user request.
translations.这次修复了多模态聊天可能在开头多塞一个标记的问题: This fixes an extra start token that could appear in multimodal chat
